notes.title: UPDATE DEMO 25/07/2025
notes.content: [p]-Updated game physics so that Timmy jumps to standard height even if he is standing on a descending platform.[/p][p]-Updated key and controller settings.[/p][p]-Added full screen/windowed mode.[/p][p]-You can now hit Crabby to “motivate” him to run faster.[/p][p]-The end of the Schnecker level has been reworked.[/p][p][/p][p]There you go, it took me a while, but it was worth it :)[/p]
